prompt: Create an original 60 second chamber classical instrumental composition for celebration, positive conclusion and project reveal. Mood: hopeful, joyful, uplifting. Instruments: string quartet, clarinet. Style: interlocking counterpoint and expressive legato. Tempo approximately 98 BPM; C major. Main idea: a compact three-note motif. Introduce a memorable rising motif, develop it, and end with a confident resolved cadence. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A lively and elegant classical piece featuring a string ensemble, characterized by its intricate melodies, dynamic shifts, and a playful, sophisticated atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首活泼优雅的古典乐曲，以弦乐合奏为主，旋律错综复杂，动态变化丰富，营造出一种俏皮而精致的氛围。
